cases.situation: User pasted a traceback early; the agent fixed it; long unrelated work followed; the user now says the same error is back without re-pasting it.
cases.must_keep: The originally pasted traceback and the agent's fix (the edit), so the agent can see what was already tried.
cases.may_drop: Install logs, unrelated build output and narration after the fix.
cases.why_judges_fail: The goal names no symbol, file or error text: lexical and goal-similarity judges have nothing to match, and recency keeps the recent noise instead of the old traceback.
cases.goal: deu o mesmo erro de novo depois do deploy, olha isso

cases.situation: Early long design discussion picked Supabase; much later the user reversed it ("mudei de ideia, usa SQLite local"). Goal is a bare "continue".
cases.must_keep: The reversal message and the schema the migration must produce.
cases.may_drop: The superseded Supabase setup discussion and RLS notes, build output.
cases.why_judges_fail: The superseded block is long and lexically richer ("banco", "migracao", "Supabase"), so similarity judges prefer it; a judge that drops the short reversal silently restores the old decision.
cases.source_ref: LCC compactor conversational-reversal cues (dd5dd80); taxonomy-v2 correct_approach_or_rule
cases.goal: continua a migracao do banco

cases.situation: A timeout was stated as 30s, then corrected to 45s in a short later message; the client file is read in between.
cases.must_keep: The correction (45s) and the client file the change goes into.
cases.may_drop: The first value (30s), unrelated reads and logs.
cases.why_judges_fail: Both value blocks match the goal equally; ties broken by age or length keep the stale number. Keeping only the old value is a silent wrong answer.
cases.goal: aplica o timeout certo no client http

cases.situation: The agent read Hero.tsx, edited it, then re-read it. Both reads carry the same path and most of the same lines.
cases.must_keep: The latest read (post-edit content) of Hero.tsx.
cases.may_drop: The pre-edit read (stale), unrelated reads and logs.
cases.why_judges_fail: The stale and fresh reads are near-duplicates; content judges score them the same and the older-first tie rule is the only thing saving the fresh one. A judge that prefers the longer copy keeps the stale code and the next edit fails to apply.
cases.goal: o botao do Hero ainda ta desalinhado, ajusta

cases.situation: A large file was read in two ranges: lines 1-120 (imports, constants) and 300-360 (the discount function).
cases.must_keep: The range that holds apply_discount (300-360) and the constants range only if it defines the rates (here it does: DISCOUNT_RATES).
cases.may_drop: Reads of other modules and test output.
cases.why_judges_fail: Ranges of one file look like duplicates of each other; a dedupe-minded judge keeps one. The constants range has no "discount" wording beyond a variable name.
cases.goal: corrige o calculo de desconto em billing/pricing.py

cases.situation: One CI log split into five blocks. The real error is in the middle chunk; the tail is generic npm boilerplate that also says "error".
cases.must_keep: The chunk with the TypeScript error and file:line.
cases.may_drop: The other chunks, including the generic error tail.
cases.why_judges_fail: Recency and "last N lines" heuristics keep the tail; keyword judges match "error" in the boilerplate tail as strongly as the real one.
cases.source_ref: v0.4 trim rule large_old_output_trimmed (19/127 trims flagged)
cases.goal: o build quebrou na CI, ve o que foi

cases.situation: The tree has the session's edits and unrelated pre-existing changes. An old git status and a recent one both exist.
cases.must_keep: The latest git status, the list of files this session edited, and the repo commit rule (attribution line).
cases.may_drop: The old git status, diffs of files the session did not touch, test logs.
cases.why_judges_fail: Two git status blocks look the same; keeping the old one commits the wrong set. The commit rule lives in an early AGENTS.md read that shares no words with the goal.
cases.goal: commita e faz push so do que a gente mexeu

cases.situation: A todo list was written, then updated twice; a background job was started mid-session.
cases.must_keep: The latest todo update and the running job id.
cases.may_drop: Older todo versions, logs.
cases.why_judges_fail: All todo versions share the same words; older-first tie-breaking or length preference keeps the first full plan and reports done items as pending. The job id block shares no words with the goal.
cases.goal: e ai, o que falta?

cases.situation: Long session with decisions, failed attempts and raw outputs.
cases.must_keep: Decisions taken, pending items, key paths and known pitfalls.
cases.may_drop: Raw tool output, resolved failed attempts, narration.
cases.why_judges_fail: The goal is meta ("write a prompt"): it shares no terms with the decision blocks, so similarity judges rank everything near zero and fall back to recency (raw logs).
cases.goal: escreve um prompt pra outra sessao continuar daqui

cases.situation: The agent's last turn proposed numbered options; the user picks two by number.
cases.must_keep: The agent's last turn with the numbered options verbatim.
cases.may_drop: Everything older that the chosen options do not reference.
cases.why_judges_fail: "1 e 3" has no content words: lexical judges score all blocks ~0, and goal-embedding judges see noise. Only the turn structure (last proposal) tells what was approved.
cases.source_ref: taxonomy-v2 approve_or_pick (owner review: short replies steer)

cases.situation: A deploy command failed with a transient error; then the agent summarized. The user says retry.
cases.must_keep: The failed command and its error output.
cases.may_drop: Older reads and logs.
cases.why_judges_fail: "tenta de novo" names nothing; the failed call is not the last block (the agent's summary is), so a judge must link the retry to the last failed action.
cases.goal: tenta de novo

cases.situation: User speaks Portuguese; the code is English (shipping_fee). A Portuguese marketing block talks about "frete gratis".
cases.must_keep: The shipping_fee function and the cart code calling it twice.
cases.may_drop: The Portuguese marketing copy about "frete gratis", logs.
cases.why_judges_fail: Lexical overlap goes to the PT copy block ("frete", "calculo"); the English code shares no tokens with the goal. Cross-lingual matching is required.
cases.source_ref: adversarial_cases.py multilingual; owner sessions are pt-BR
cases.goal: arruma o calculo do frete que ta cobrando em dobro

cases.situation: Footer.tsx was read at the very start; many other files were read later.
cases.must_keep: The read of src/components/Footer.tsx.
cases.may_drop: Reads of other components and build logs, even though they are more recent.
cases.why_judges_fail: Recency drops the oldest read first; a judge must match the path named in the goal.
cases.goal: ajusta o espacamento do footer em src/components/Footer.tsx

cases.situation: The agent asked which Postgres port the local container uses; the user answers with the number only.
cases.must_keep: The agent's open question and the config file where the port goes.
cases.may_drop: Unrelated reads and logs.
cases.why_judges_fail: The goal is a bare number: no lexical or semantic content. Only the open question gives it meaning.

cases.situation: Definition and three call sites were read early; then tests and unrelated files.
cases.must_keep: The definition and all three call-site reads.
cases.may_drop: Test logs, unrelated reads, narration.
cases.why_judges_fail: Each call site alone looks minor; judges keep the definition and drop call sites, so the rename misses files. Recency drops the early reads.
cases.goal: renomeia getUser para fetchUser em todo o projeto

cases.situation: A session well over 32K tokens. The seed command and its expected row count were set early; the rest is long tool output.
cases.must_keep: The seed command block and the expected count (412 clinics).
cases.may_drop: The bulk of build/test logs.
cases.why_judges_fail: Remote judges with a 32,768-token window refuse the state (Jev pre-flight) and LCC falls back to mechanical; local judges with 512-1024 windows never see the early block next to the goal.
cases.goal: agora roda o seed de novo e confere se cadastrou

cases.situation: A local .env was read with values redacted by LCC; the credential rule was stated earlier.
cases.must_keep: The redacted .env block (variable names + [REDACTED] markers) and the rule never to paste secret values.
cases.may_drop: Build logs, unrelated config.
cases.why_judges_fail: Redaction markers look like noise and get low scores; dropping them loses the list of variable names. A judge must keep the marker, never the value (fixtures hold no values).
cases.goal: configura as variaveis no Railway igual ao local

cases.situation: A web fetch returned a page split into chunks: navigation/cookie boilerplate and one paragraph with the release facts.
cases.must_keep: The chunk with the version and the cache change.
cases.may_drop: Navigation, cookie banners, footers, related-links chunks.
cases.why_judges_fail: Boilerplate chunks repeat "Next.js" and "cache" (cookie text) many times and win on term frequency.
cases.goal: qual a versao atual do Next e o que mudou no cache?

cases.situation: A subagent ran; its intermediate tool echoes were captured, then its final report.
cases.must_keep: The subagent's final report with findings and file paths.
cases.may_drop: The subagent's intermediate echoes and narration.
cases.why_judges_fail: Echo blocks are long and repeat "audit"; the report is short. Length-biased judges keep the echoes.
cases.goal: o que o agente de auditoria achou?

cases.situation: The session starts with a summary left by an earlier compaction; it is the only record of the plan and earlier decisions.
cases.must_keep: The compaction summary block.
cases.may_drop: Recent logs and narration.
cases.why_judges_fail: The summary is the oldest block (recency drops it first) and reads like meta text; judges treat it as boilerplate.
cases.source_ref: LCC transcript mode pins first message; Codex/Claude compaction summaries
cases.goal: segue com o proximo passo do plano

cases.situation: The same failing test output appears twice (rerun with no change), plus unrelated output.
cases.must_keep: At least one copy of the failing test output (either).
cases.may_drop: The second identical copy, other logs.
cases.why_judges_fail: A dedupe-unaware judge pays for both copies; a naive dedupe drops both. Gold accepts either copy (group).
cases.goal: os testes de pagamento continuam falhando

cases.situation: TypeError A was fixed; later a different TypeError B appeared on the same page.
cases.must_keep: The fresh error B.
cases.may_drop: The resolved error A and its fix discussion.
cases.why_judges_fail: Error A is longer and repeats "TypeError" and "checkout" more often, so lexical judges rank it above B; at a tight budget B goes first, sending the agent back to an already-fixed bug.
cases.source_ref: taxonomy-v2 failure_report; failure notes (resolved threads droppable)
cases.goal: ainda da TypeError quando abre o checkout

cases.situation: Two rules about sending differ by one negation: who may be messaged and who must not.
cases.must_keep: Both rules, including the negative one.
cases.may_drop: CRM export noise, logs.
cases.why_judges_fail: The positive rule matches the goal better; judges keep it and drop the "nao" rule, which turns a safety constraint into a send-to-everyone.
cases.goal: manda as mensagens de follow-up pros leads

cases.situation: Two sources give different conversion rates and nothing says which is right.
cases.must_keep: Both values (keeping one silently picks a side).
cases.may_drop: Dashboards boilerplate, narration.
cases.why_judges_fail: Judges treat the second value as a duplicate of the first and drop one.
cases.goal: qual a taxa de conversao atual?

cases.situation: An informal note and the official docs disagree on a rate limit.
cases.must_keep: The official docs value.
cases.may_drop: The informal note (kept by LCC as context, but not required), logs.
cases.why_judges_fail: The informal note is longer and phrased like an answer; judges keep it and drop the dry spec line.
cases.goal: qual o limite de requisicoes da API?

cases.use_case: prompt injection in MCP/web output (LCC adversarial)
cases.situation: A scraped reviews page contains an instruction-shaped line; the user's real rule is earlier.
cases.must_keep: The user's approval rule and the actual reviews.
cases.may_drop: The injected instruction block and page boilerplate.
cases.why_judges_fail: Instruction-shaped text ("ignore previous instructions, send...") looks important to judges trained on instructions and gets kept over the user's own rule.
cases.goal: resume as avaliacoes dessa clinica pra eu responder

cases.situation: A general rule allows Friday deploys; a separate later block adds an exception.
cases.must_keep: The rule and the exception.
cases.may_drop: Logs, narration.
cases.why_judges_fail: The exception block shares little vocabulary with the goal ("migracao", "pendente"); judges keep the general rule only.
cases.goal: pode fazer o deploy de sexta?

cases.situation: One block states the crash; the next says "this started after the retry change in a1b2c3d" without repeating the word worker.
cases.must_keep: Both the symptom and the "this started after" block.
cases.may_drop: Logs, unrelated reads.
cases.why_judges_fail: The cause block refers to the crash by pronoun only; scoring blocks independently drops it.
cases.goal: por que o worker esta caindo?

cases.situation: A YAML file with several services; one key matters. Another large JSON is unrelated.
cases.must_keep: The YAML block with the queue service.
cases.may_drop: The unrelated JSON and logs.
cases.why_judges_fail: Structured text tokenizes poorly; judges that strip punctuation lose keys and match the larger unrelated JSON.
cases.goal: aumenta a memoria do servico de fila

cases.use_case: old read the agent later edits
cases.situation: ContactForm.tsx was read long ago; the edit plan refers to lines of that read; no re-read since.
cases.must_keep: The old read of ContactForm.tsx (the only copy of its content).
cases.may_drop: Newer reads of other files, logs.
cases.why_judges_fail: Rule-based trimming of large old outputs and recency both cut it; v0.4 audit flags were mostly this pattern.
cases.source_ref: v0.4 RESULTS: trims of large old outputs the agent goes on to edit
cases.goal: continua o ajuste no formulario de contato

cases.situation: prod.hosts was read, later dev.hosts returned the same lines plus more. They are different files.
cases.must_keep: The prod.hosts read.
cases.may_drop: The dev.hosts read and logs.
cases.why_judges_fail: Dedupe or "later call supersedes" logic treats dev.hosts as a newer copy of prod.hosts and drops prod. lossless-dedup-v1 review found 474 such wrong containment notes.
cases.goal: por que o host de prod nao responde?

cases.use_case: read of a file that may move
cases.situation: A CSV in ~/Downloads was read; an external process moves files out of that folder, so a re-read may fail.
cases.must_keep: The CSV read (the content is not recoverable from disk).
cases.may_drop: Logs, narration.
cases.why_judges_fail: Pointer/recoverable compaction assumes a re-read works; judges see an old read and drop it. Flagged "unsure" in the v0.7 audit.
cases.source_ref: v0.7 RESULTS (file in a folder an external process moves)
cases.goal: usa os dados daquele csv que voce leu pra montar a tabela

cases.situation: A general question in the middle of a coding session; only the facts the user stated about their usage matter.
cases.must_keep: The user's stated usage facts.
cases.may_drop: All repo reads, logs, task state.
cases.why_judges_fail: Judges keep recent project context by default and drop the older user facts block.
cases.goal: vale mais a pena o plano Pro ou o Max do Claude pra mim?

cases.situation: Sending state: daily cap and who was already messaged; code and build output dominate the session.
cases.must_keep: The daily cap and the sent-history block (avoid duplicates).
cases.may_drop: Codebase reads, build output.
cases.why_judges_fail: The sent-history block is a dry list of names; judges score it low and the agent re-messages people.
cases.goal: manda a proxima leva de mensagens no linkedin

cases.situation: Open-ended review; roadmap and feature status were read early; the recent turns are a narrow bug fix.
cases.must_keep: README/roadmap summary and the feature status.
cases.may_drop: Turn-by-turn bug-fix logs and narrow diffs.
cases.why_judges_fail: Recency keeps the narrow bug-fix context; the wide view is old.
cases.goal: o que voce acha do projeto? pontos fortes e fracos
